NONE: › said when someone would do anything to achieve what they want to achieve
死也要…

example: She'll finish the race or die in the attempt.
她即使累死也要跑完全程。

NONE: B2 used to say what will happen if another thing does not happen
否則，要不然
B2 used to compare two different things or situations
（用於對比兩種不同的事物或情形）要不，要麽
› informal used as a threat, sometimes humorously
（表示威脅，有時是一種幽默的說法）要不然，否則的話

example: We must be there by six, or else we'll miss the beginning.
我們一定要在六點前趕到那裡，要不然就會錯過開場。
She's either really talkative and you can't shut her up or else she's silent.
她要麽滔滔不絕，你都堵不了她的嘴，要麽就一言不發。
He'd better find it quickly, or else (= or I will punish him in some way)!
他最好馬上找到它，要不然，哼！

NONE: › used to emphasize that the stated thing will not make any difference
（用於強調所說事物不會有影響）或沒有

example: Extra pay or no extra pay, I'm not going to work late again tonight.
不管有沒有加班費，今晚我都不打算再工作到很晚。

NONE: › used to refer to the opposite of the word that comes before it
或相反

example: Hand in your test papers, finished or otherwise (= or not finished).
把試卷交上來，不管有沒有做完。

NONE: B1 approximately
大約，左右

example: They raised two hundred dollars or so for charity.
他們為慈善事業募集了大約200美元。

NONE: A2 used to show that what you have just said is only an example or you are not certain about it
諸如此類的，…之類的東西

example: She works for a bank or something.
她爲一家銀行或類似的機構工作。
Why don't you go to a movie or something?
你爲什麽不去看電影或做點類似的事呢？

NONE: C1 approximately or a little more than
大約，左右；多一點兒
B1 used to talk about a small number or amount of something
（用來描述少數的或少量的）

example: I'll be with you in a minute or two.
我過一兩分鐘就到。
It's a good year or two since we last met.
從我們上次見面以來已有一年多了。
It will only take a minute or two.
只要好一兩分鐘。

NONE: › informal used at the end of a phrase for emphasis
（用在句末表示強調）

example: Are you stupid or what?
你是蠢還是什麼？
